# ReleaseKit-Swift

Native iOS 17+ release notes/community SDK. Swift 6, system frameworks only.
Repository: https://github.com/adamkvcs95/ReleaseKit-Swift
Candidate: 1.0.0-rc.5; stable 1.0.0 requires the signed real-iPhone App Attest release gate.
Configure once with the public rk_pub_ app key. Automatic updates: .releaseKitWhatsNew(). Explicit changelog: .releaseKitChangelog(isPresented:). Navigation: ReleaseKitSettingsLink()/ReleaseKitChangelogView().
Includes release/comment votes, automatic comments, pseudonyms, report/block, private offline cache/ETags, bounded event queue and optional DeviceCheck App Attest. Reads remain available on unsupported devices; required attestation blocks their writes.
Full integration and limitations: README.md, AGENTS.md, RELEASE_CHECKLIST.md, CHANGELOG.md.
Never promise stable or physical-device validation based only on compilation or Apple sample vectors.
